_comment_target_items: Priority order. The first item whose button becomes clickable is the one clicked. Use the exact text shown on the drop page; partial matches are fine and case is ignored.
_comment_add_to_cart_pattern: Case-insensitive regex matched against button text. Run `recon` against a live drop page and widen this if it matches nothing.
_comment_headless: Keep false. You want to see the window and take over checkout by hand.
_comment_auto_submit_payment: Not implemented on purpose. Payment is yours to confirm.
_comment_max_wait_minutes: How long `arm` sits on the page before giving up. Cover the whole waiting room plus slack.
